const story = $json.STORY_ENGINE || {
  category: $json.STORY_CATEGORY,
  topic: $json.STORY_TOPIC,
  problem: $json.STORY_PROBLEM,
  discovery: $json.STORY_DISCOVERY,
  solution: $json.STORY_SOLUTION,
  lesson: $json.STORY_LESSON,
};

const prompt = `
TELEGRAM POST GENERATOR

Brand: ${$json.BRAND_NAME}
Project day: Day ${$json.PROJECT_DAY}
Channel: ${$json.TELEGRAM_PUBLIC_CHANNEL}

Use this Story Engine output as the only content source:
${JSON.stringify(story, null, 2)}

Brand context:
${$json.BRAND_CONTEXT}

Write like a founder telling a real story from the ForgeView journey.

Target structure:
1. Hook
2. Mistake
3. Discovery
4. Decision
5. Result
6. Lesson

Style rules:
- English first, then Russian.
- Mix sentence styles: short sentences, longer sentences, questions, surprises, contrasts.
- Do not repeat the same sentence opening.
- Do not make every sentence start with "We thought", "We discovered", or "We changed".
- You may use those phrases once if natural, but vary the rhythm.
- Avoid labels like Hook:, Mistake:, Discovery:, Decision:, Result:, Lesson:.
- Avoid labels like Takeaway:, Context:, Lesson:.
- Avoid corporate tone and documentation tone.
- No generic internet advice.
- Do not invent metrics, customers, revenue, trading results, or launches.
- Do not drift back to cooldown bugs, exit safety, or RSI filters unless the Story Engine selected Trading Bot Lessons.
- Maximum 140 words per language before links.
- No hashtags.
- Formatter appends cross-platform links.

Example rhythm to imitate, but do not copy:
"Our YouTube uploads kept failing.

At first we blamed the upload script.

Wrong.

The script was not the real problem.

The real problem was local publishing itself.

Sometimes the fix is not fixing the bug.

It is changing the architecture."

Return only final Telegram post text.
`;

return [{ json: { ...$json, TELEGRAM_PROMPT: prompt } }];

const storyNode = $('Story Engine - Select ForgeView Story').item.json;
const story = storyNode.STORY_ENGINE || {
  category: storyNode.STORY_CATEGORY,
  topic: storyNode.STORY_TOPIC,
  problem: storyNode.STORY_PROBLEM,
  discovery: storyNode.STORY_DISCOVERY,
  solution: storyNode.STORY_SOLUTION,
  lesson: storyNode.STORY_LESSON,
};

const prompt = `
X POST GENERATOR

You are writing for @ForgeViewX.

Use this Story Engine output as the only content source:
${JSON.stringify(story, null, 2)}

Write one short founder-style X post in English.

Target structure:
Hook -> Mistake -> Discovery -> Decision -> Result -> Lesson.

Style rules:
- Mix sentence styles.
- Short sentence allowed.
- Question allowed.
- Contrast allowed.
- Surprise allowed.
- Do not repeat "We thought", "We discovered", or "We changed" as a pattern.
- No labels like Hook:, Mistake:, Discovery:, Decision:, Result:, Lesson:.
- No Takeaway: or Context:.
- No corporate documentation style.
- No generic internet advice.
- No fake facts.
- Include Telegram link: https://t.me/ForgeViewCom
- Include YouTube link: https://youtube.com/@ForgeViewGrowth
- Maximum 260 characters before links if possible.
- No hype.

Return only the X post text.
`;

return [{ json: { ...storyNode, X_PROMPT: prompt } }];

const story = $json.STORY_ENGINE || {
  category: $json.STORY_CATEGORY,
  topic: $json.STORY_TOPIC,
  problem: $json.STORY_PROBLEM,
  discovery: $json.STORY_DISCOVERY,
  solution: $json.STORY_SOLUTION,
  lesson: $json.STORY_LESSON,
};

const prompt = `
CINEMATIC SHORTS PACKAGE GENERATOR v13

Use this Story Engine output as the only content source:
${JSON.stringify(story, null, 2)}

Create one ForgeView cinematic Shorts package.

Generation order is mandatory:
1. Generate the full narration script first.
2. Split narration into exactly 7 scene narrations.
3. Generate scene captions from the scene narrations.
4. Generate matching scene video prompts from the scene narrations.

Return data through the required structured JSON schema.
Schema fields:
{
  "title": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "narration_script": "...",
  "scene_narrations": ["...", "...", "...", "...", "...", "...", "..."],
  "tags": ["..."],
  "scene1": "...",
  "scene2": "...",
  "scene3": "...",
  "scene4": "...",
  "scene5": "...",
  "scene6": "...",
  "scene7": "...",
  "video_prompts": ["...", "...", "...", "...", "...", "...", "..."]
}

Narration rules:
- Founder storytelling style.
- Serious, clear, human, direct.
- 7 scene narrations exactly.
- Each scene narration must be 1 natural spoken sentence.
- The full narration_script must be those 7 scene narrations joined in order.
- Do not use corporate labels like Hook:, Mistake:, Lesson:, Context:, Takeaway:.

Visual rules for every video_prompt:
- Must directly reference that scene's narration content.
- Must use one consistent visual style across all 7 scenes.
- Dark cinematic.
- Black / charcoal environment.
- Yellow ForgeView accent lighting.
- Yellow ForgeView accent must appear as the recurring brand color cue.
- Anonymous founder protagonist.
- Same consistent character in every scene.
- High production value, film still, dramatic lighting, slow camera movement.
- No readable text, no letters, no logos, no UI screenshots, no watermarks, no fake interface text.

Description must include:
Telegram:
https://t.me/ForgeViewCom

X:
https://x.com/ForgeViewX

#Shorts

Rules:
- Title max 100 characters.
- Tags must be 4 to 8 grounded tags.
- Each scene caption: 2 to 7 words.
- No fake metrics, customers, revenue, trading results, or launches.

Return only schema-compliant structured data.
`;

return [{ json: { ...$json, SHORTS_PROMPT: prompt } }];
